create_TensorCircularBuffer: create a TensorCircularBuffer instance with a specified capacity for storing tensor data
append_data_to_buffer: append nested tensor data to the circular buffer and get the insertion index
extend_buffer_with_data: extend the circular buffer with a sequence of nested tensors or stacked data
get_item_from_buffer: get a value from the circular buffer by key or access an item by index
review_TensorCircularBuffer_methods: review the TensorCircularBuffer class methods including front, back, at, empty, reset, and clear
